setup.refresh_when_case_says: replace strict-preparation instance with normal current instance
setup.oracle: actual SFC test-only myChart getter sampled at primary SDK scene/plot destroy entry and refreshed wrapper destroy entry; teardown or strict-owner handoff window only; separate per-wrapper and per-SDK counts

invariants: Each distinct owned resource has at most one current destroy entry or strict primary SDK invocation, tracked separately by identity and layer; current throwing entry need not delegate.
Without refresh, the prepared/current instance is destroyed once under either order.
After refresh, the old prepared instance and new current instance are each destroyed once under either order.
Repeated unmount and handle.dispose after either order do not increase any destroy count.
The current instance reference is cleared synchronously before its destroy call.
No query, Store publication, or target mutation is caused by teardown.
forbidden_collapses: Do not merge old prepared instance and refreshed current instance identities.
Do not treat a thrown destroy as proof of successful SDK/GPU release.
Do not treat component doubles as real-browser reachability or vendor SDK acceptance.
Do not count these cases as chart-type denominator coverage.

semantic_fingerprints: 刷新完成后unmount→handle dispose重复销毁
expected_red.exact_failure_count: 由固定案例写前执行观察，不预填
